r16-desk-fixes.title: Desk fixes: menus, where it opens, double-click and lines
body: Four fixes from your message, all in one pull request. The pictures show each one. Three of them have a choice worth a second look.

**Line break in menus.** When you right-click, the menu draws a lifted copy of the thing you clicked. The copy could come out half a pixel narrower than the real one, or lose the text size of where it sat, so a title that just fits broke onto a second line. It now keeps the exact width and text settings.
**Where it opens.** On starting, the Desk opens on the middle of your cards and boxes instead of the corner of the paper.
**Double-click.** An entry from an earlier day now opens its details like today's do (before, nothing happened and only the small notepad showed). A ticket opens its notepad on a screen of its own.

**Lines.** Cards that share a ticket link one to the next, oldest first, instead of every card to every other. A card gets one word link, not two. A line you drew is never doubled by an automatic one. Lines also update as soon as a notepad window saves, so they don't all pop in later, and a card in a pile has its lines go to the pile.

body: While fixing the lines I looked for what else makes a full Desk hard to use. These four are new (none were on the earlier lists). Tick the ones you want; the first two are my picks because they help every day and are small.
